authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states from live G02 v1 exactByteIntent. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a D-006 unit or accounting method. It does not authorize 83886080 as a bound. It does not decide L-TCB identity. It does not populate the per-OS TCB table. It does not retarget DR-126. It does not invent an occupancy leftover-join. It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not close OBL-2. It does not execute G02. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of G02 fixture authoring by naming initial states drawn from live G02 v1 exactByteIntent, with NOT-AUTHORED markers attached to those named states.
